content.title: Chapter 102 - UTILITIES — Sec. 102-283. - Conflicts.
content.summary:
If a dispute or conflict arises between a provision of this article and the provisions
               of any technical code, specification, rule, or regulation adopted by the city, the
               director shall determine which assembly, non-testable device, or method is most appropriate
        …

faqs.a:
If a dispute or conflict arises between a provision of this article and the provisions
               of any technical code, specification, rule, or regulation adopted by the city, the
               director shall determine which assembly, non-testable device, or method is most appropriate
               for the circumstance based on the identified contaminant and other relevant hazards.
(
Ord. No. 4829
, § 1, 12-5-2022)
